VibePascal v54 -- aarch64-darwin native compiler (runs on Apple Silicon macOS)
Source commit: b7d2d9676ecf1d7d8250cd460b9c48069920513e
Compiler fix:  b9cb8fea875670cfc48f7d83b88d4af39a28aa6e
Parent release: v53 (9e20efe4d6912fe6a9558c442ae4fa8d5dfe3045)
Built: 2026-09-03 on x86_64-linux
Binary: bin/ppca64  md5 edd3b4dd66347b45add3c781291ef16f

Change: an untyped INTEGER initialiser for an inline var (and for an inferred
`for var i := ...` counter) now infers NativeInt instead of the hard-coded
LongInt -- pointer width, so 8 bytes on a 64-bit target and 4 on a 32-bit one.
A string/char literal initialiser now infers exactly what a bare `string`
denotes at that point (wide under -Mdelphiunicode/-Munleashed; ShortString
under $H-, which earlier releases got wrong).  Only types narrower than
NativeInt are widened, so Int64/QWord keep their width; explicit typecasts
such as byte(10) are never promoted.

COMPILER BINARY ONLY.  Nothing in the RTL, the packages or the PPU format
changed between v53 and v54, so an existing unit set for this platform stays
valid.  Full change + validation record: dist/win64/staging-v54/VERSION.txt.

RUNTIME NOT VERIFIED ON THIS PLATFORM.  The build host is x86_64-linux; this
binary was cross-built from the identical source commit and its file format was
verified, but it has never been executed.  Only the x86_64-linux binary (and,
for the i386 target, its generated output) were actually run.
